title: The Making of Gunplay’s Smash Hit “Bucket List” With Producer J. Manifest
htmlContent:
Super-producer J. Manifest is having a moment now because of his work behind the boards on Gunplay's smash hit "Bucket List" But the Rocky Mount, North Carolina-based producer has a whole lot more going on than one track.

J. Manifest is the producer of choice for many of the rappers starting to make the move to the mainstream. Already working with artists such as Gunplay, Wiz Khalifa, Beanie Sigel, Project Pat, Money Bagg Yo, Yung L.A, Elhae, Curren$y, T-Pain, Young Dolph, Colonel Loud, Rick Ross, Anthony Hamilton, and more all rely on J. Manifest. The producer has hit songs to his credit in Rick Ross‘s “Drug Dealers Dream”, Anthony Hamilton’s “Love is the New Black'' and Gunplay's “Bucket List” Featuring “Ricco Barrino”. J.Manifest has made a name for himself as a hip-hop producer in the past few years solidifying his place as one of the hottest producers in hip hop. 

In addition to producing,  Whether it be as a producer or businessman, J. Manifest is a name to know in the music scene. J. Manifest has recently worked closely with Gunplay on his new album “ALL Bullshit Aside”, which he manages to produce “Bucket List” Feat. “Ricco Barrino”, an American R&B singer and songwriter from High Point, North Carolina. He has already made a huge difference in Gunplay’s Album and we are excited for Gunplay, Producer J. Manifest developed a new sound on “Bucket List”. Be sure to stay on the lookout for J. Manifest’s name as it is bound to be everywhere in the coming years.
